entry.title: Anchan Indigo
entry.content:
This project at Anchan Indigo was completed by M Studio as an interior design project developed in accordance with the client’s brief and lifestyle requirements. Unlike a full furniture package, our role here was focused on creating the design concept, planning the spaces and developing tailored interior solutions for the villa.

The design was created with careful attention to the client’s specific needs and the way the family would use each area of the home. In this project, we designed several important functional spaces, including a sauna, a children’s bedroom with a dedicated play area, and a private home office for the owner. Each room was planned to be both practical and visually cohesive, while maintaining a calm, elegant atmosphere throughout the villa.

Special attention was also given to the outdoor living area. One of the key design features is the natural stone outdoor fireplace, which adds warmth, texture and character to the space. In the evening, it creates a beautiful and inviting atmosphere, making the outdoor area feel especially cosy and comfortable for relaxing or spending time with family and guests.

The result is a refined and thoughtfully designed villa interior that reflects the client’s vision while combining comfort, function and timeless style.
entry.summary: Interior design for a villa at Anchan Indigo: sauna, children’s bedroom with a play area, home office and an outdoor stone fireplace

entry.title: Manor Phuket
entry.content:
This project at Manor Phuket was completed by M Studio as a full furniture package developed specifically for the villa.

The architecture of the house already included a number of soft, rounded elements, and our goal was to continue this design language throughout the furniture and interior styling. We repeated these curved forms in selected furniture pieces and details so that the interior would feel naturally connected to the architecture rather than visually separate from it.

For this project, we used solid teak wood furniture, chosen for its durability, natural texture and suitability for the tropical climate of Phuket. The furniture was custom-made specifically for the villa according to the dimensions and proportions of each space.

The pieces were produced at our factory in Indonesia, where we were able to control the materials, proportions and overall quality of the furniture throughout the production process. This allowed us to create a cohesive collection that works as one complete concept rather than a mix of unrelated individual items.

The final result is a warm, contemporary interior with a natural tropical character. The combination of solid teak, soft curves and carefully selected proportions creates a calm and balanced atmosphere that complements the architectural style of Manor Phuket.

Every piece was developed as part of M Studio’s complete furniture package, with attention to both functionality and the overall visual harmony of the villa.
entry.summary: Furniture package for a villa at Manor Phuket: custom solid teak furniture made at our factory in Indonesia

entry.title: Layan Lucky Villas
entry.content:
This project was completed as a full furniture package by M Studio, with the furniture, décor and styling developed specifically for this villa.

The interior was designed in a contemporary Asian style, combining natural materials, handcrafted furniture and a light, calm color palette. Following the client’s preference for bright and airy interiors, we kept the overall atmosphere soft and neutral, allowing the natural textures of wood to become an important part of the design.

Many furniture pieces were custom-made from solid teak wood according to the exact dimensions and proportions of each room. Teak was chosen for its natural beauty, durability and timeless character, making it especially suitable for tropical living.

To add depth and individuality to the contemporary interior, we incorporated selected antique pieces made from carved wood and sourced from India. These unique elements bring a sense of history and craftsmanship to the space while creating a beautiful contrast with the clean, modern lines of the new furniture.

Several tables were also custom-made from solid mango wood, adding another warm and natural texture to the interior.

The result is a light, comfortable and timeless villa interior where contemporary Asian design, traditional craftsmanship and natural materials come together in a relaxed and elegant way. Every furniture piece was selected or created specifically for the property as part of M Studio’s complete furniture package.
entry.summary: Furniture package for Layan Lucky Villas: custom solid teak and mango wood furniture with antique carved pieces from India
